[Section] Methodology ::: BERT ::: BERT(Token-CLS)
[source_id=19] Since every target in a sentence needs to be disambiguated to find its exact sense, WSD task can be regarded as a token-level classification task. To incorporate BERT to WSD task, we take the final hidden state of the token corresponding to the target word (if more than one token, we average them) and add a classification layer for every target lemma, which is the same as the last layer of the Bi-LSTM model BIBREF11.
